items.title: fix(plugins): channels..enabled=false no longer loads the channel…
items.summary: fix(plugins): channels..enabled=false no longer loads the channel plugin when its plugin entry is enabled (#136211) * fix(plugins): honor channels..enabled=false over plugin entry enablement A channel plugin whose channel is switched off in config (`channels..enabled: false`) kept loading whenever `plugins.entries..enabled: true` was also present, which is exactly the state `openclaw plugins install @openclaw/` and `openclaw plugins enable` leave behind. Auto-enable, the Gateway startup plan, channel presence policy and the official-external repair targets all already treat that channel flag as an explicit disable; the shared activation decision was the one owner that did not, so every unscoped registry load (CLI plugin registry, agent runtime loads, outbound bootstrap) still imported the plugin. On git-built installs of source-external plugins (discord, slack: `build.bundledDist: false`) that import is what surfaced as startup ERROR lines: the build links `dist/extensions//node_modules` back to `extensions//node_modules`, and a moved or pruned checkout leaves that link dangling, so the import fails with `Cannot find module` for a channel the operator had turned off. - Teach the shared activation decision a closed `channel-disabled-in-config` cause and make the channel-config reader tri-state (`resolveChannelConfigEnablement`), so `channels..enabled: false` wins the same way `enabled: true` already opts a bundled channel in. - When an externally distributed plugin fails to import because a module is missing, name the enablement path in the loader error (`openclaw plugins install ` / `openclaw doctor --fix`) at both loader failure sites so `status`/`doctor` show what to do next. - Align the stale WhatsApp repair-hint test with the npm-first install ordering from #134490. Regression tests fail on pre-fix code at the activation decision and at the loader (bundled telegram fixture with the channel disabled and the plugin entry enabled). * fix(plugins): report missing dependencies for externally distributed bundled plugins Follow-up to the channel-disable activation fix, addressing review findings. - Plugin status skipped dependency health for every bundled-origin plugin, so a source-external plugin (`build.bundledDist: false`) compiled into `dist/extensions/` without its plugin-local `node_modules` never showed the typed "required dependencies are missing" state in `plugins list`, `status`, or `doctor`; the only signal was the raw import error at load time. Narrow the gate: bundled plugins that are distributed outside the root package now get dependency status like external installs. - The activation metadata hash only fingerprinted channels with `enabled: true`, so adding `enabled: false` produced the same registry cache key as an absent flag and could reuse a registry that had already loaded the plugin. Serialize the boolean tri-state instead. - Guard the missing-module cause walk in `recordPluginError`: a plugin-thrown error may expose a throwing `cause` accessor, and diagnostics inside a catch handler must not rethrow it out of the loader loop. All four regression tests fail on the previous commit. * test(plugins): split dependency-health snapshot cases out of the oversized status suite * fix(plugins): verify the official package before naming its install command The missing-dependency hint resolved the official install command from the plugin id alone, so a foreign `build.bundledDist: false` package reusing an official id (for example a Discord fork registered as `discord`) would be told to install `@openclaw/discord` over itself. Resolve the catalog entry by package name and require canonical-id equality; other externally distributed packages get a generic reinstall/update hint instead. The mismatched-package regression fails on the previous commit. * fix(plugins): resolve channel disables through manifest-owned channel ids Review follow-ups on the channel-disable activation fix: - The activation decision resolved `channels..enabled` from the plugin id alone, so a plugin whose id differs from its channel key (QQ Bot documents `openclaw-qqbot` owning `channels.qqbot`) never saw the operator's disable. Thread manifest-owned channel ids from both loaders into the shared decision and check them before the built-in catalog mapping. - Runtime status dropped package build metadata, so a generic source-external bundled plugin (`build.bundledDist: false` without an official catalog entry) was treated as an ordinary bundled plugin and its missing dependencies never surfaced in `status`/`doctor`. Carry the installed index's `packageBuild` into the runtime dependency-status decision. - Guard nested error-code reads in the missing-module classifier: a nested error with a throwing `code` getter must not escape the loader's catch. Every regression fails on the previous commit. * fix(plugins): pass manifest channel ids to every activation consumer The channel-disable decision only received manifest-owned channel ids from the two module loaders, so metadata consumers that publish a plugin's declared surfaces (skills, hooks, embedded settings, startup planning, presence policy, index writes, provider inventory, public-surface access) still activated a renamed-channel plugin such as `openclaw-qqbot` after `channels.qqbot.enabled: false`. Pass `channels` from the manifest or installed-index record at every call site that has one; id-only callers keep the built-in catalog mapping. The skills regression (bundled `openclaw-demo` owning `channels.demo`) fails on the previous commit. * fix(plugins): honor channel disables and source-external dependency health in index and managed diagnostics Two remaining consumers of the activation decision and dependency-status gate: - `isInstalledPluginEnabled` evaluated a renamed-channel plugin from its id alone, so contribution and command-default consumers still saw `openclaw-qqbot` as enabled after `channels.qqbot.enabled: false`. Pass the index record's channel ids. - Gateway `plugins.list` diagnostics excluded every bundled-origin plugin from dependency health, so an enabled `build.bundledDist: false` plugin with missing required dependencies was listed without its error. Use the shared `tracksPluginDependencyStatus` gate there too. Both regressions fail on the previous commit.

items.title: Apple再促淘汰Intel Mac應用，macOS 27將成Rosetta通用支援最後一版
items.summary: Apple再次提醒Mac開發者，macOS 27將是Rosetta一般用途支援的最後一版。使用Apple silicon晶片的Mac升級至macOS 27後，仍可透過Rosetta執行僅提供Intel版本的應用程式，但從macOS 28起，除部分舊遊戲外，一般Intel版應用程式將無法繼續執行。

items.title: 近2.2萬臺Exchange Server暴露於漏洞導致的接管風險，臺灣也有250臺
items.summary: 微軟在8月份例行更新修補的Exchange Server高風險漏洞CVE-2026-62911，近日引發關注，該漏洞的CVSS評分達8.0分，屬於權限提升問題，可能導致攻擊者接管受害主機上的所有使用者郵箱，包括收發信件與下載附件，影響Exchange Server 2016與2019版，以及Exchange Server訂閱版（SE）。

items.title: John Ternus正式接任蘋果執行長
items.summary: 蘋果本周二（9/1）正式完成備受矚目的執行長交接，由硬體工程資深副總裁John Ternus接替掌舵15年的Tim Cook，成為蘋果新任執行長，Cook則轉任董事會執行董事長。當天蘋果股價上漲了2.61%，以325.13美元作收。 現年51歲的Ternus自2001年加入蘋果產品設計團隊，2013年升任硬體工程副總裁，2021年進入執行團隊擔任硬體工程資深副總裁，在蘋果已服務25年。

items.title: 偉訓部分資訊系統遭網路安全事件，已隔離受影響系統並啟動調查
items.summary: 上市電子零組件廠偉訓（3032）於8月30日晚間，在股市公開資訊觀測站發布資安重訊，表示已偵測到部分資訊系統遭受網路安全事件，在發現異常後立即啟動資安應變機制，隔離受影響的資訊系統並進行風險控管，同時委請外部專業資安廠商協助系統復原及事件調查。

items.title: 為因應零時差漏洞攻擊活動，PaperCut三度發布緊急修補程式
items.summary: 上週列印管理系統供應商PaperCut警告，旗下的PaperCut NG與PaperCut MF系統存在零時差漏洞CVE-2026-82078、CVE-2026-81578，並在兩天內兩度發布緊急修補程式，隨後有多家資安公司揭露相關攻擊活動，美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）也表示掌握漏洞遭積極利用

items.title: Meta推出即時音訊模型Muse Voice Transcribe，Mac按住Fn鍵即可系統級語音輸入
items.summary: Meta周二（9/1）正式推出由超級智慧實驗室（Meta Superintelligence Labs，MSL）所開發的首個即時音訊感知模型Muse Voice Transcribe。該模型將串流式自動語音辨識、說話者分離（Diarization）與端點偵測（Endpointing）整合於單一模型之中，用戶說話時系統可同步輸出文字，無需等待完整錄音結束後再進行後製處理。
